## Preamble

This script runs GO Enrichment using `topGo` on our `DESeq2` analysis results. This script is adapted from the Lecture 7.3 script provided by MICB 405 at the University of British Columbia Vancouver (2026W1).

## 1. Load Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(topGO)
```

## 2. Generate Gene Universe

```{r}
# Create Mapping Table
geneID2GO <- readMappings("../data/GO_enrichment/GO_terms/mesaur_GOIDs.tsv")

# Generate `topGO` Gene Universe
geneUniverse <- names(geneID2GO)
```

## 3. Load Lists of Differentially Expressed Genes

```{r}
# Load raw gene lists
results <-read_tsv("../data/DESeq2/sam_all_diff_expressed.tsv")
upreg <- results %>% filter(log2FoldChange >= 1)
downreg <- results %>% filter(log2FoldChange <= -1)

# Convert to characters
upreg_names <- as.character(upreg$gene_id)
downreg_names <- as.character(downreg$gene_id)

# Convert to factors
upreg_gene_list <- factor(as.integer(geneUniverse %in% upreg_names))
downreg_gene_list <- factor(as.integer(geneUniverse %in% downreg_names))
names(upreg_gene_list) <- geneUniverse
names(downreg_gene_list) <- geneUniverse
```

## 4. Build topGOdata Objects

```{r}
upreg_GO_data <- new("topGOdata",
                     description = "mesaur_interaction_4dpi_vs_80dpi_upreg",
                     ontology = "BP",
                     allGenes = upreg_gene_list,
                     annot = annFUN.gene2GO,
                     gene2GO = geneID2GO)

downreg_GO_data <- new("topGOdata",
                       description = "mesaur_interaction_4dpi_vs_80dpi_downreg",
                       ontology = "BP",
                       allGenes = downreg_gene_list,
                       annot = annFUN.gene2GO,
                       gene2GO = geneID2GO)

```

## 5. Run Statistical Tests on topGOdata Objects

```{r}
upreg_res <- runTest(upreg_GO_data,
                     algorithm = "weight01",
                     statistic = "fisher")

downreg_res <- runTest(downreg_GO_data,
                       algorithm = "weight01",
                       statistic = "fisher")
```

## 6. Extract Summary of Up-regulated & Down-regulated GO Terms

```{r}
upreg_GO <- GenTable(upreg_GO_data,
                     weight01 = upreg_res,
                     orderBy = "weight01",
                     ranksOf = "weight01",
                     topNodes = 50,
                     numChar = 1000)

downreg_GO <- GenTable(downreg_GO_data,
                       weight01 = downreg_res,
                       orderBy = "weight01",
                       ranksOf = "weight01",
                       topNodes = 50,
                       numChar = 1000)
```

## 7. Visualize Significant Up-regulated GO Terms

```{r}
upreg_GO_filt_arrange <- upreg_GO %>%
  mutate(GeneRatio = Significant/Annotated, weight01 = as.numeric(weight01)) %>%
  filter(weight01 <= 0.05) %>%
  head(n = 20) %>%
  arrange(GeneRatio) %>%
  mutate(Term = factor(Term))

upreg_order_term <- upreg_GO_filt_arrange %>% 
  pull(Term)

upreg_plot <- upreg_GO_filt_arrange %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x= Term,y = GeneRatio, colour = weight01, fill = weight01)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.05) +
  geom_point(aes(size = Significant)) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = upreg_order_term,
                   labels = \(x) stringr::str_wrap(x, width = 30)) + 
  scale_colour_gradient(low = "red", high = "blue") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "red", high = "blue", guide = "none") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "GO Term (Biological Process)", 
       y = "Enrichment Ratio", 
       color = "p-value (weight01)", 
       size = "Gene Count") + 
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black"),
        panel.grid = element_line(colour = "grey96")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1),
                     breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
                     expand = c(0, 0.05)) 

ggsave("../visualizations/GO_enrichment/upreg_genes_lolipop.png",
       plot = upreg_plot, width = 10, height = 10)

upreg_plot
```

```{r}
  geom_point(aes(size = Significant)) +

                   labels = \(x) stringr::str_wrap(x, width = 45)) + 
  scale_colour_gradient(low = "red", high = "blue") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "red", high = "blue", guide = "none") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "GO Term (Biological Process)", 
       y = "Enrichment Ratio", 
       color = "p-value (weight01)", 
       size = "Gene Count") + 
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black"),
        panel.grid = element_line(colour = "grey96")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1),
                     breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
                     expand = c(0, 0.05)) 

ggsave("../visualizations/GO_enrichment/downreg_genes_lolipop.png",

downreg_plot
```

## 9. Visualize Both Sets of Significant GO Terms Together

```{r plot-updown, warning=FALSE, message = FALSE}
upreg_GO <- upreg_GO %>% mutate(up_down = "Up-regulated")
downreg_GO <- downreg_GO %>% mutate(up_down = "Down-regulated")

joined_GO_filt_arrange <- bind_rows(upreg_GO, downreg_GO) %>%
  mutate(GeneRatio = Significant/Annotated, weight01 = as.numeric(weight01)) %>%
  filter(weight01 <= 0.05) %>%
  arrange(desc(GeneRatio)) %>%
  mutate(Term = factor(Term)) %>%
  head(n = 40)

joined_order_term <- joined_GO_filt_arrange %>% 
  pull(Term)

updown_plot <- joined_GO_filt_arrange %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x= Term, y = GeneRatio, color = weight01, fill = weight01)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = Significant)) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = joined_order_term,
                   labels = \(x) stringr::str_wrap(x, width = 75)) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "red", high = "blue") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "red", high = "blue", guide = "none") +
  scale_size(range = c(2, 10), breaks = c(2, 6, 10)) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "GO Term Description", 
       y = "Enrichment Ratio", 
       color = "p-value (weight01)", 
       size = "Gene Count") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.2),
                     breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  facet_grid(. ~ up_down) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 9),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black"), 
        panel.grid = element_line(colour = "grey96"), 
        strip.background = element_rect(colour = "black"))

updown_plot

ggsave("../visualizations/GO_enrichment/upreg_and_downreg_genes_lolipop.png",
       plot = updown_plot, width = 12, height = 10)
```

## 10. Extract Genes Associated with Enriched GO Terms

```{r}
# Read gene ID to GO term(s) mapping table
mesaur_GOIDs <- read_tsv("../data/GO_enrichment/GO_terms/mesaur_GOIDs.tsv",
                         col_names = c("gene_id", "GO_id"))


# Pull top 3 GO terms with highest enrichment ratio (significant genes/annotated genes)
# among up-regulated and down-regulated GO terms
top5_up_enriched_GO_id <- upreg_GO_filt_arrange %>%
  arrange(desc(GeneRatio)) %>%
  head(n = 3) %>%
  pull(var = GO.ID)

top5_down_enriched_GO_id <- downreg_GO_filt_arrange %>%
  arrange(desc(GeneRatio)) %>%
  head(n = 3) %>%
  pull(var = GO.ID)


# Select rows from mapping table that contain our GO term of interest
up_enriched_GO_id_filt <- mesaur_GOIDs %>%
  filter(grepl(pattern = paste(top5_up_enriched_GO_id, collapse = "|"), GO_id))

down_enriched_GO_id_filt <- mesaur_GOIDs %>%
  filter(grepl(pattern = paste(top5_down_enriched_GO_id, collapse = "|"), GO_id))


# Vectors of gene IDs to select
up_enriched_gene_id_vec <- up_enriched_GO_id_filt %>% pull(gene_id)
down_enriched_gene_id_vec <- down_enriched_GO_id_filt %>% pull(gene_id)


# Filter gene lists for those in the vectors above
up_enriched_genes <- upreg %>%
  filter(gene_id %in% up_enriched_gene_id_vec)

down_enriched_genes <- downreg %>%
  filter(gene_id %in% down_enriched_gene_id_vec)


# Join gene lists and label by regulation direction
all_most_enriched_genes <- bind_rows(up_enriched_genes, down_enriched_genes) %>%
  mutate(reg_label = if_else(log2FoldChange > 0, "Up-regulated", "Down-regulated")) %>%
  arrange(log2FoldChange)

all_enriched_order <- all_most_enriched_genes %>% 
  dplyr::select(gene_id) %>% 
  pull()


# Generate & save plot
all_most_enriched_plot <- all_most_enriched_genes %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = gene_id, y = log2FoldChange, fill = reg_label)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = log2FoldChange-lfcSE, ymax = log2FoldChange+lfcSE), width = 0.4) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = all_enriched_order) +
  coord_flip()+ 
  labs(y = expression(log[2]("Fold Change")),
       x = "Gene ID",
       fill = "") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  theme_light() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-6,6), breaks = seq(-6, 6, 2), expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#3B82F6", "#EF4444")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave("../visualizations/GO_enrichment/all_most_enriched_genes_bar.png",
       plot = all_most_enriched_plot, width = 10, height = 10)

all_most_enriched_plot
```
